critical_code_review_comments: DistributorDashboard.jsx KPICard emits a React warning: 'props object containing a "key" prop is being spread into JSX'. Pass key={...} directly on the JSX element instead of spreading it from an object. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

routes/distributor_os.py contains a dead 'placeholder' loop (lines ~191-197 — `active_prev = active_prev; break`) right before the active_prev_set is built; safe to delete, it never affects the result.

_build_distributor_os is ~310 lines in a single function — consider extracting the per-retailer matrix builder and KPI assembler into small helpers for readability (file currently 578 lines, under 700-line threshold but trending up).

Spark arrays for retail_orders_pending / inventory_units / low_stock_skus / dispatched_30d are flat repeats of the same value (e.g. `[v]*12`). Sparklines render but convey no trend — acceptable for v1, worth replacing with real time-series in a follow-up.
